mapper.select: SELECT A.CONCERT_NO AS concertNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.CONCERT_TIME AS concertTime , A.VENUE AS venue , A.TCT_SITE AS tctSite , A.TCT_OPEN_AT AS tctOpenAt , A.POP_SCORE AS popScore , A.REG_TIME AS regTime , B.SEND_YN AS sendYn , A.GENRE AS genre , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ARTIST_MSG AS B ON A.ARTIST_NM_KOR = B.ARTIST_NM_KOR AND A.CONCERT_YEAR = B.CONCERT_YEAR AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = B.CONCERT_MONTH AND A.CONCERT_DATE = B.CONCERT_DATE WHERE CONCAT(A.CONCERT_YEAR, '-', LPAD(A.CONCERT_MONTH, 2, '0')) BETWEEN CONCAT(#{frYear}, '-', LPAD(#{frMonth}, 2, '0')) AND CONCAT(#{toYear}, '-', LPAD(#{toMonth}, 2, '0')) AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(A.CONCERT_YEAR, '-', A.CONCERT_MONTH, '-', A.CONCERT_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') > CURDATE();

SELECT A.CONCERT_NO AS concertNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.CONCERT_TIME AS concertTime , A.VENUE AS venue , A.TCT_SITE AS tctSite , A.TCT_OPEN_AT AS tctOpenAt , A.POP_SCORE AS popScore , A.REG_TIME AS regTime , A.SEND_YN AS sendYn , A.GENRE AS genre , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A WHERE A.CONCERT_NO = #{concertNo}

SELECT A.CONCERT_NO AS concertNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.CONCERT_TIME AS concertTime , A.VENUE AS venue , A.TCT_SITE AS tctSite , A.TCT_OPEN_AT AS tctOpenAt , A.POP_SCORE AS popScore , A.REG_TIME AS regTime , A.SEND_YN AS sendYn , A.GENRE AS genre , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A WHERE STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(A.CONCERT_YEAR, '-', LPAD(A.CONCERT_MONTH, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(A.CONCERT_DATE, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d') >= CURDATE() AND ( A.CONCERT_TIME IS NULL OR TRIM(A.CONCERT_TIME) = '' OR TRIM(A.CONCERT_TIME) = '미정' OR TRIM(A.CONCERT_TIME) = '0000' OR A.VENUE IS NULL OR TRIM(A.VENUE) = '' OR TRIM(A.VENUE) = '미정' OR A.TCT_SITE IS NULL OR TRIM(A.TCT_SITE) = '' OR TRIM(A.TCT_SITE) = '미정' OR A.TCT_OPEN_AT IS NULL OR TRIM(A.TCT_OPEN_AT) = '' OR TRIM(A.TCT_OPEN_AT) = '미정' ) ORDER BY A.CONCERT_YEAR, A.CONCERT_MONTH, A.CONCERT_DATE, A.POP_SCORE DESC
SELECT A.EMAIL FROM TB_EMAIL AS A WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONCERT_INFO SET SEND_YN = 'Y' WHERE CONCAT(CONCERT_YEAR, CONCERT_MONTH, CONCERT_DATE) BETWEEN CONCAT(#{concertYear}, #{concertMonth}, #{concertDate}) - 7 AND CONCAT(#{concertYear}, #{concertMonth}, #{concertDate}) + 7 AND ARTIST_NM_KOR = #{artistNmKor}
mapper.select: SELECT A.CONCERT_NO AS concertNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.CONCERT_TIME AS concertTime , A.VENUE AS venue , A.TCT_SITE AS tctSite , A.TCT_OPEN_AT AS tctOpenAt , A.POP_SCORE AS popScore , A.REG_TIME AS regTime , A.SEND_YN AS sendYn , A.GENRE AS genre , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A WHERE SEND_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT A.CONCERT_NO AS concertNo , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR AS artistNmKor , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR AS artistNmFor , A.CONCERT_YEAR AS concertYear , A.CONCERT_MONTH AS concertMonth , A.CONCERT_DATE AS concertDate , A.CONCERT_TIME AS concertTime , A.VENUE AS venue , A.TCT_SITE AS tctSite , A.TCT_OPEN_AT AS tctOpenAt , A.POP_SCORE AS popScore , A.REG_TIME AS regTime , A.SEND_YN AS sendYn , A.GENRE AS genre , A.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A WHERE (SEND_YN = 'N' OR SEND_YN IS NULL) AND CONCAT(CONCERT_YEAR, '-', LPAD(CONCERT_MONTH, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CONCERT_DATE, 2, '0')) >= CURDATE() ORDER BY POP_SCORE DESC LIMIT 1
